title: Let omission metadata give way before evidence in the brief's clipping and outcome steps too
outcome: Once evidence must give way in the independent evaluator brief, the shrink order still prefers verbose omission metadata over citable evidence and outcome text. The detail-major clipping loop should try the Compact omission detail at each window before clipping more entries. The outcome should be shortened only after the Compact (and Minimal) windows are exhausted.
acceptance: Let omission metadata give way before evidence in the brief's clipping and outcome steps too is done
